finding: ProcessVec calls enqueue hardware work; the model blocked until all MTE3 completion
action: Advance Scalar after issue, gate BMM2 input on Vec1 MTE3 completion; include final pending hardware events
limitation: Scalar PMU cost remains an upper-demand proxy containing polling

finding: The model added max(worker startup) and max(batch startup), potentially selecting different critical roles
action: Use max(cube worker + cube batch, vector worker + vector batch)

finding: Previous branch evaluation substituted original frozen SameAB forecasts instead of evaluating the branch model
action: Calculate the branch prediction separately; preserve original forecast and hash in separate columns
limitation: Original SameAB collection forecasts remain immutable; new branch model is experimental

finding: UNSPLITK uses two-block TSCM copies; generic SDK depth-based load count has different units
action: Derive loads as ceil(Mtiles*Ktiles/2)+ceil(Ntiles*Ktiles/2) for this source implementation
limitation: Correct source counts do not independently identify transfer latency

finding: Prediction loader silently recalibrated from cached measurements after an SDK change
action: Prediction reads immutable model only; SDK identity is recorded, never used to trigger fitting

finding: Previous training omitted supplied historical complete PMU measurements and current SameAB inputs
action: Audit all valid input-derived configurations in both supplied measurement corpus and flat diagnostics; retain a source inventory
limitation: Non-successful numerical checks and incomplete PMU remain excluded with counts

finding: C220 KFC polls messages; Scalar busy includes polling and cannot be equated with useful issue service
action: Explicitly disqualify independent stage-cost claims; retain resulting errors in evaluation
limitation: No independently identified useful Scalar service cost; point predictions remain experimental

finding: Generic two-live-chunk limit uses logical read/write bytes as if they were allocated UB; actual code uses separate static buffers and V_MTE2/MTE3_V flags
action: Keep as a documented unresolved approximation; do not call this an exact buffer model
limitation: Muls, Softmax, Cast split costs and exact buffer-release timing are not identified

finding: min(depthA1,depthB1) is not an operand-specific SDK L1 cache lifetime model
action: Record the unsupported approximation and SDK geometry differences
limitation: Cache lifetimes depend on iteration order, steps and shared B state

finding: Class splitting leaves rank-deficient cost systems; NNLS selects one coefficient allocation without identifying physical stage costs
action: Report every cost class rank, sample count and heldout error; no shape-specific acceptance rules
limitation: One General heldout fold has only one calibration input; its 1331us startup estimate is a model artifact

finding: Phase pipe values are sums on the critical pair, not whole-device active sums or independent stage wall times
action: Label their exact scope and retain whole-kernel PMU comparisons separately

finding: Per-core input and output queues each have depth one with distinct buffer lifetimes; sum of total services omits possible overlap
action: Keep explicit limitation; no hardware-verified per-chunk prefix timeline is claimed

finding: 4032 and 42192 reuse exceptions occur in official v8.5.0 Host source
action: Retain official conditions; they are not fitted per-shape latency answers

finding: Vec2 chunk base uses dSizeAlign16, even when V/output width differs
action: Retain source rule instead of replacing it with an intuitive DV formula

finding: Forecast loading/writing errors were outside the per-case measurement exception handler
action: Record forecast unavailable and continue measurement; never use an unwritten forecast as a prospective prediction

finding: Saved forecasts checked input identity but did not recheck the recorded model hardware
action: Check saved model hardware before reuse; preserve original snapshot

finding: These data and errors have already been inspected
action: Report as grouped development replay, not prospective validation; keep numerical failures and unavailable predictions visible
